svg.title: Stage 1 Preamp Saturation Comparison: C_IN = 1 uF vs C_IN = 68 nF
svg.text: Key Simulation Finding — Preventing Stage 1 (U1A) Saturation with C_IN = 68 nF
Input: 5 mV Breathing Artifact (0.25 Hz) + In-Ear Cardiac Signal (~300 µVpp) | Preamp Gain: R_G = 220 Ω (×455.5 / 53.2 dB)
+ Severe saturation step transients at ADC_IN
Zero baseline drift, centered at 1.650 V (8192)
